# Glossary

Terms every boxoffice context shares. A context that means something narrower by
one of these words defines it again in its own glossary.

## Event

A single performance at a single venue, starting at a single time. A run of six
nights is six events.

- **Aliases:** performance
- **Status:** validated
- **Example:** The Thursday and Friday shows of the same play are two events.

## Fan

A person who buys or holds a ticket. A fan is not required to have an account
until payment.

## Venue

The building a fan walks into, and the seat map that describes it.

- **Aliases:** house
- **Status:** draft
- **Example:** A venue with two balconies has one seat map covering all three levels.
